name: ai-assistant
title: AI Assistant
description: Primitives for AI chat that take the Vercel AI SDK’s useChat as it is: a scrolling log that puts each new question at the top with its reply growing below, opens a saved conversation at its last question and reads each reply out once it has finished, messages that show thinking, tool calls, Markdown, files and sources, copy, regenerate and feedback actions, suggested prompts, a welcome, an error with retry, context chips, a message box that attaches files and where Enter sends and Stop halts a reply, and a hook that runs the same chat from any function that streams.
